credits.title: Always Yours, Never Mine
credits.overview: Across thirty years, several almosts, and timing that is never quite right, two people keep crossing paths – always on the verge of being together, but never quite making it.

credits.title: Manila's Finest
credits.overview: Set during the first quarter storm in the 1970s, policemen Homer, Conrad, and Billy are consumed by the murder case of troublemaking teenagers in the slums.

credits.title: The Last Resort
credits.overview: At a beach resort, a housekeeper hides a deadly secret—she kills predatory men and keeps their wedding rings as trophies. When a charming guest witnesses her latest attack, she fears exposure, until she senses something darker behind his smile.

credits.title: I Remember You
credits.overview: Inspired by true stories, the movie is set in the scenic island of Boracay where Gani (Santos), a bank employee, is forced to return to the island he left to heal a broken heart. As he begins to create a new life, Debby (Montenegro), his ex, shows up.

credits.title: Santigwar
credits.overview: When a group of fun-seeking boys head to an abandoned town, Hasmin will soon discover the truth that binds her Santigwar family to the Aswangs.

credits.title: G!
credits.overview: A series of good times, bad times, cherished bonding moments which will make them all realize the value of love, friendship, family and life.
